project_info.name: Alberto Pantoja - La Voz del Campo
project_info.domain: Santo Domingo de los Tsáchilas, Ecuador
project_info.rationale: The political campaign is 'La Voz del Campo' (The Voice of the Countryside) representing rural workers and agriculture. The user explicitly requested 'green is common for RC5' alongside a rural theme. This perfectly aligns with Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy). The design will use high-end agricultural imagery, rich forest greens, soil-inspired accents, and authoritative typography to convey leadership, trustworthiness, and approachability.

rules: Use tracking-tight for all headings above 32px (text-4xl and up).
Never use Inter, Roboto, or generic sans-serif for headings.
Labels and overlines must be Uppercase + tracking-[0.2em] + text-xs.
Ensure fluid scaling for large hero text (max text-6xl).

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Use p-12, p-16, and p-20 for sections. Containers with borders must have internal padding.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Use 'MODE A: THE TETRIS GRID' for the media gallery and 'La Voz del Campo' initiatives. Mix spans like col-span-8 and col-span-4 to create asymmetry.
surfaces: Header: Glassmorphism with 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80' and a subtle 1px border-b border-[#00A75D]/10.
Cards: Neumorphism (Tactile) variants. Flat background matching parent (or pure white) with sharp 1px border-black/5 and soft shadow.

motion.hover_states: Buttons must smoothly transition background and ensure text color remains high-contrast (e.g., hover:bg-[#008B4D] hover:text-white).
motion.interactions: Use Framer Motion for subtle fade-ups on scroll (especially the bento grids and media elements).

hero_background.description: Lush green agricultural fields in Santo Domingo. Use as full-screen or large block hero background with a bg-black/40 overlay for text contrast.

soil_hands_growth.description: Hands holding soil with a sprout. Ideal for the 'About/Mission' section background or card.

alberto_pantoja_portrait.description: Portrait of Alberto Pantoja. Use in the hero section overlaying the background, or in the dedicated About/Biography section.

rc5_logo.description: RC5 Party Logo Placeholder. Use in header and footer.

rally_image.description: Crowd/political rally image. Use in the 'Political Position' section.

components_and_sections.header: Sticky crystal glassmorphism header. Must include: RC5 Logo, Nav links (Home, Bio, Media, Contact), Language Switcher (ES | FR | EN as simple text buttons or Shadcn Select), and a primary 'Únete' CTA button.
components_and_sections.hero: Hero image (hero_background) with bg-black/40 overlay. Headline: 'La Voz del Campo' in text-5xl or text-6xl, tracking-tight, white text. Subheading: 'Alberto Pantoja - Consejal de Santo Domingo'. Place the alberto_pantoja_portrait overlapping the bottom of the hero or in a split asymmetrical layout.
components_and_sections.about_bio: Split layout. Use generous p-16 spacing. Left: The soil_hands_growth image or text block explaining his roots. Right: The bio detailing his role as Provincial Director of Revolución Ciudadana.
components_and_sections.media_gallery: Bento Grid layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8). Embed YouTube and Facebook iframes directly. The iframes must be wrapped in an aspect-video container with rounded corners and overflow-hidden.
components_and_sections.contact: A dedicated section containing the JotForm. Use an <iframe> pointing to the JotForm URL (use a placeholder JotForm link if none provided, e.g., 'https://form.jotform.com/233251234567890'). Ensure the form container has a solid white background with a subtle shadow to pop against the #F6F7F2 page background.
components_and_sections.footer: Dark background (#1A2B22). Light text. Include social links (FB, TikTok, LinkedIn) using lucide-react icons. Include the fworksbuilders_logo at the bottom with text 'Site 9 / Multi-tenant Platform'.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a React + JavaScript application (NOT TypeScript). Do not use .tsx files. Use .js or .jsx.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for structural marketing layouts. Heavily customize Shadcn components if you need interactive logic (like Select for Language switcher).
Install 'lucide-react' for all icons (Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn, MapPin, Mail, etc).
Ensure every interactive element (buttons, language switchers, form inputs, links) has a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case, e.g., 'data-testid="nav-contact-link"'.
Implement the 'La Voz del Campo' vibe. Use the provided earthy off-white background and deep green colors. Avoid generic 'SaaS' looks.
For the multi-lingual setup, use a simple state-based dictionary or i18next if preferred. Make sure the ES | FR | EN switcher actively toggles the static text on the site.
In the media section, use raw HTML <iframe> elements for Facebook and YouTube videos. Keep them responsive using Tailwind's aspect-ratio classes ('aspect-video w-full').
JotForm MUST be embedded using an <iframe> tag within the Contact section.
